description: Local preparation contract consumed by the farm importer; not a general JSON Schema.

history.format: UTF-8 TSV, one header line, no embedded tabs or newlines in cells
history.yearMeaning: Harvest year, including winter crops sown in the previous calendar year
history.missingArea: Blank or zero; never estimate from memory

profile.crs: Local metric WGS84 UTM: EPSG:32601–32660 or EPSG:32701–32760, chosen from the farm location
profile.fieldAliases: Optional object: exact boundary field_name -> exact history Field
profile.expected: Optional non-negative integer counts: historyRows, historyFields, boundaryFeatures, aliasMatches

boundaries.coordinates: WGS84 longitude, latitude; closed rings with at least four positions
boundaries.uuid: Unique stable identifier for each supplied boundary
boundaries.matching: One boundary per history field; reviewed aliases allowed
boundaries.splitFields: Separate stable field codes and supplied geometries for each cropped part; unresolved splits must not be imported as whole-field crops
